alternative_explanations: The public grammar is solved by a simpler symbolic map; learning may not add value.
confounds: One seed and a visible local synthetic task; this is a new cohort and cannot isolate individual v1 repair effects.
falsification_criteria: Any missing cell, malformed answer, failed control, resource overrun or integrity failure closes this calibration as inconclusive.

cost_contract.durability: fsynced per-cell journal; failed outcomes retain completed cells
cost_contract.latency: synchronized end-to-end batch=1 raw samples, pooled p50/p95; separate measured batch throughput
cost_contract.operation_counts: exact public parser/index primitive counters and explicitly estimated dense FLOPs, separated in raw costs
cost_contract.state: parameters plus current session and index; process RSS and CUDA reserved peak supervised
cost_contract.workload_unit: one mean world: input once and all 16 queries repeated R times; global fit evenly charged over 135 final worlds

invalidation_rules: Missing answers, world/cell coverage or costs invalidate the comparison
Any terminal outcome consumes the one registration; no automatic retry
No private generator, answers or strata may reach a candidate before prediction
No post-calibration recipe, threshold, selection or seed change

recipe.frozen_control: same initialization and inference as BM25 pair reader; zero updates
recipe.retrieval: actual BM25 k1=1.2 b=0.75, top 4; identical learned pair model and disclosed iterative path loop
recipe.sampling: balanced cells and worlds, randomized subjects, exact key mismatch negatives
recipe.seed_source: one runner_random_v1 seed shared across roles
recipe.selection: none; fixed final optimizer step; dev evaluated once for competence only

outcome_policy.negative: Close this exact baseline recipe and report the failed gates without falsifying the broader family.
outcome_policy.null: Retain all outcomes and stop; no retry or tuning.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep calibrated controls for a separately authorized mechanism question, without architecture claims.

predicted_outcome: Symbolic control is exact; learned controls must meet 0.85 overall and 0.80 replacement accuracy, and learned BM25 must exceed its frozen control by 0.05.
promotion_criteria: No architecture promotion or economic claim from this calibration.
research_question: Can the fixed pair transformer and true BM25 pair reader meet frozen quality gates with valid full accounting on fresh worlds?
